privileged_info_for_vlm: The initial orbital elements for NORAD 59001 are: Semi-Major Axis (SMA) = 6621.14 km, Eccentricity (ECC) = 0.0012, and Inclination (INC) = 41.47 degrees. The simulation must use an F10.7 solar flux value of 150 and stop at an altitude of 120 km. The final report must be located at ~/GMAT_output/reentry_prediction_report.txt and the script at ~/GMAT_output/reentry_sim.script.
